## About
Northlake Plumbing was founded by Walter Cooper, a master plumber, and serves all of metro Atlanta and surrounding counties from Shady Drive in Lilburn. Walter leads a team of journeymen and apprentice plumbers, and they take on residential and commercial work alike.
When you call, there's a good chance you'll talk to Walter himself. Reviewers mention him by name, along with David, Jeff and Eddie on the crew. We're rated 4.5 from 75 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Water Heaters - All Types Including Tankless: Water heater work of all types, tankless units included.
- Sewer & Water Line Replacement: Replacing the sewer and water lines that serve your home or building.
- Any Slow Drain: Kitchen, bath or anywhere else the water isn't going down the way it should.
- Sewer Video Inspection: A video look inside the sewer line so you can see what's going on.
- Faucets / Toilets / Sinks: Work on the fixtures you use every day.
- Bathtubs and Showers: Tub and shower plumbing for your bathroom.
- Polybutylene Piping Replacement: Swapping out old polybutylene pipe in your home.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call at night or on the weekend?
A: Yes. Walter takes calls anytime, and the business is listed as Open 24 hours every day of the week. One reviewer called on a Saturday and had a crew out that day.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. The team handles both commercial and residential plumbing service and repair.

Q: What area do you cover?
A: We're based in Lilburn and serve all of metro Atlanta and the surrounding counties.

They knew their business and acted with proper caution before proceeding. They determined the best approach and got the job done quickly and thoroughly.
